verdict.rationale: Databricks provides Structured Streaming for continuous/incremental processing with exactly-once guarantees and low latency, Lakeflow/Auto Loader declarative pipelines for incremental ETL, and Delta Lake streaming sources/sinks — directly covering streams, declarative pipelines, and incremental transformations. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on benchmark or community corroboration specifically validating streaming/continuous pipeline reliability at scale (community comments are about other aspects like cost/UX, not this capability).
